value.rationale: At the first nonprime odd-square field, two canonical pairwise optimal harmonic two-plane families exhibit sharply different higher-order rank resilience. One is 4-block full spark; the other has precisely identified 18 rank failures at both four- and five-block levels. The complete and natural configuration classification provides a quantitative structural boundary relevant to block-erasure design without requiring an extrapolation to other fields.
